headline: CrowdStrike's $43.9 billion bid for Zscaler lands as attackers exploit an abandoned ASP.NET library and India reports AI-driven bank fraud.

emerging_trends.text: Consolidation reached the top of the market: the move for Zscaler signals buyers now want one platform covering endpoints, cloud, and network traffic.
emerging_trends.topic_title: CrowdStrike Buys Zscaler in $43.9 Billion Deal

emerging_trends.text: AI-driven intrusions now cost money, as CERT-In ties AI-assisted attacks to unauthorized payments at Indian banks and technology service providers.
emerging_trends.topic_title: CERT-In Warns of AI-Assisted Bank Fraud

emerging_trends.text: Attackers keep hunting forgotten dependencies, exploiting the legacy Idunno.AntiCsrf library while enterprise edge products from Cisco and SAP fall in parallel.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Attackers Exploit ASP.NET Anti-CSRF Library Flaw

topics.title: Attackers Run Root Commands on Cisco Expressway
topics.latest_developments: SecurityWeek detailed the live attacks on SAP NetWeaver and Cisco Expressway, where threat actors leak or modify server information and execute commands as root.
topics.why_it_matters: Both products sit at the enterprise network edge, so root-level command execution gives intruders a staging point for movement into internal systems.

details.label: What to do
details.text: Install Cisco's Expressway and SAP's NetWeaver updates now. CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities listing sets a remediation deadline for federal civilian agencies.

sources.title: SAP NetWeaver, Cisco Expressway Flaws Exploited in Attacks
CISA flags critical Cisco RCE flaw as actively exploited in attacks

topics.title: CERT-In Warns of AI-Assisted Bank Fraud
topics.latest_developments: The Indian Computer Emergency Response Team said AI-assisted attacks on technology assets in India triggered unauthorized financial transactions at banks, financial services firms, and service providers.
topics.why_it_matters: Automated attack tooling now drives money out of live payment systems, pushing AI-driven intrusion from research demonstrations into measurable fraud loss.

details.label: The big picture
details.text: Amazon Threat Intelligence reported that Cairn agents, given only target addresses and a goal of shell access, found and exploited a medical imaging zero-day.

sources.title: AI-Assisted Cyberattacks Trigger Unauthorized Payments at Indian Banks and Fintech Firms
Open-source AI pentesting framework Cairn keeps turning up in real-world attacks

topics.title: HUMAN Disrupts BADBOX 3.0 Ad Fraud
topics.latest_developments: HUMAN's Satori Threat Intelligence and Research Team disrupted BADBOX 3.0, the backdoored low-cost TV box operation that peaked near 40 billion ad bid requests a day.
topics.why_it_matters: The same backdoors rent out owners' home internet connections as residential proxies, handing criminals clean IP addresses for attacks on other targets.

details.label: By the numbers
details.text: The fraud topped 4 percent of all connected TV traffic HUMAN observed and more than tripled VASTFLUX, the previous record holder.

sources.title: Infected TV boxes in BADBOX 3.0 rent out their owners' home internet
BadBox 3.0 Ad Fraud Operation Generating 40 Billion Daily Bid Requests Disrupted

topics.title: CrowdStrike Buys Zscaler in $43.9 Billion Deal
topics.latest_developments: CrowdStrike agreed to acquire Zscaler for $43.9 billion, pairing its endpoint detection business with Zscaler's cloud network security platform.
topics.why_it_matters: CrowdStrike expects the combined company to carry more than $10 billion in annual recurring revenue, shrinking buyer options across endpoint and network security.

sources.title: CrowdStrike to Acquire Zscaler in $43.9 Billion Deal

topics.title: Attackers Exploit ASP.NET Anti-CSRF Library Flaw
topics.latest_developments: Researchers told developers to abandon the legacy Idunno.AntiCsrf library after attackers exploited CVE-2026-131914, rated 9.3, for unauthenticated remote code execution.
topics.why_it_matters: Any ASP.NET application still loading the library hands attackers code execution with no credentials, and the component sits deep inside older web stacks.

details.label: What to do
details.text: Find and remove Idunno.AntiCsrf.dll versions 0.9.1.0 and 0.9.1 Beta. Researchers recommend discontinuing the library rather than waiting for a fix.

sources.title: Hackers Exploit Critical ASP.NET Anti-CSRF Library Flaw Allowing Unauthenticated RCE

topics.title: Two States Sue Musk Over Grok Deepfakes
topics.latest_developments: The attorneys general of Oregon and Virginia sued SpaceX and other Elon Musk companies, alleging weak safeguards let Grok produce sexualized imagery of real people, including children.
topics.why_it_matters: State consumer protection law now reaches model safety design, creating legal exposure for any company shipping generative image tools to the public.

sources.title: States Sue SpaceX Over Grok Deepfakes

business_politics.title: Asian Regulators Move to Calm AI Rout
business_politics.latest_developments: Regulators and market operators in China, South Korea, and Taiwan rolled out emergency measures Monday, November 23, to arrest the global selloff in artificial-intelligence shares.
business_politics.why_it_matters: Asian chipmakers and hardware suppliers anchor index weightings worldwide, and official intervention signals policymakers now treat the AI unwind as a financial stability risk.

details.label: The big picture
details.text: United States stock futures and European technology shares rallied sharply Monday as investors bought the dip. Nvidia and Anthropic both rose before the open.

details.label: What to watch
details.text: Treasury and European government bond yields rose, reversing much of last week's steep decline, and gold climbed 3% ahead of United States inflation data.

sources.title: Asian Regulators Step Up Efforts to Calm AI-Driven Market Turmoil
Asian regulators rush to support sagging markets as AI trade falters
Wall Street set to rebound after AI stock sell-off
Gold Climbs 3%, Focus on Rate-Hike Bets

business_politics.title: CrowdStrike Buys Zscaler for $44 Billion
business_politics.latest_developments: CrowdStrike agreed Monday, November 23, to buy Zscaler in an all-stock swap valued at $44 billion, merging two of the largest American cybersecurity vendors.
business_politics.why_it_matters: The deal concentrates endpoint and network security spending in a single supplier as banks and governments absorb a wave of technology outages.

details.label: Between the lines
details.text: Rapidly evolving artificial-intelligence threats have pushed digital defense onto boardroom agendas, and businesses and governments worldwide are still grappling with repeated disruptions.

sources.title: CrowdStrike to Buy Zscaler in $44 Billion Stock Swap
CrowdStrike to buy Zscaler in $44bn deal as cyber security disruptions mount

business_politics.title: Ukraine Sinks Russian Warship in Libya
business_politics.latest_developments: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Monday, November 23, that Ukrainian sea drones sank a Russian warship moored at the Benghazi naval base in Libya.
business_politics.why_it_matters: Ukraine now strikes Russian vessels thousands of miles from the front, widening war risk for shipping, insurers, and ports across the Mediterranean.

details.label: The big picture
details.text: Ukrainian drones also hit Russian cargo vessels far from the battlefield. Zelenskyy called the Benghazi operation exemplary.

sources.title: Ukraine blows up Russian warship in Libya's Benghazi naval base
Ukraine Sinks Russian Warship, Hits Cargo Vessels Far From Warzone

business.title: Denis Theatre Owners Weigh Reopening or Sale
business.latest_developments: The Denis Theatre's owners said the shuttered Mt. Lebanon movie house could reopen in about two years or go up for sale, PublicSource reported Monday, November 23.
business.why_it_matters: The outcome decides whether Mt. Lebanon's Washington Road district regains an anchor venue or hands the landmark building to a new buyer.

details.label: What they're saying
details.text: Jon Delano said Mt. Lebanon "deserves a performing arts center of some sort" and that saving the Denis carries economic value for the community.

sources.title: Denis Theatre owners say it could reopen in two years — or go up for sale

business.title: Red Button Smash Rents Pinball Machines
business.latest_developments: Red Button Smash delivers pinball machines to Pittsburgh customers' rec rooms, Pittsburgh City Paper reported Monday, November 23.
business.why_it_matters: Households can now keep arcade hardware at home without buying a machine, adding a local vendor to the region's entertainment market.

details.label: What they're saying
details.text: The company's founders credit millennial nostalgia and weariness of screens for the local interest in the service.

sources.title: Red Button Smash delivers pinball machines right to your rec room

around_town.title: Indiana Township Drafts Data Center Rules
around_town.latest_developments: Indiana Township supervisors are preparing new regulations for data centers before any developer files an application, TribLive reported Monday, November 23.
around_town.why_it_matters: Writing the rules first gives supervisors control over where and how a data center could be built in the township.

sources.title: Indiana Township supervisors considering data center restrictions

around_town.title: Westmoreland Buses Crowd as Ridership Climbs
around_town.latest_developments: Westmoreland County Transit Authority buses are getting crowded as ridership jumps, and the authority is pursuing additional state funding, TribLive reported Monday, November 23.
around_town.why_it_matters: Riders face fuller buses until the authority can add service, which depends on the Harrisburg money it is now chasing.

sources.title: Westmoreland bus ridership jumps as authority eyes additional state funding

around_town.title: Penn Township Weighs Fire Tax Increase
around_town.latest_developments: Penn Township commissioners are considering raising the municipality's fire tax next year to fund stipends for dedicated daytime firefighters, TribLive reported Monday, November 23.
around_town.why_it_matters: Daytime coverage would no longer rest solely on volunteer availability, and Penn Township property owners would pay for the change.

sources.title: Fire tax increase would pay dedicated daytime firefighters in Penn Township

events.title: Sewickley Light Up Night Set for December 4
events.latest_developments: Sewickley will hold its Light Up Night with fireworks, food trucks, and live music, and borough officials expect about 10,000 guests, TribLive reported Monday, November 23.
events.why_it_matters: The borough's largest holiday celebration fills its business district for one evening, a draw for Sewickley merchants and visiting families.

sources.title: Sewickley Light Up Night to bring fireworks, food trucks, live music Dec. 4

events.title: Craft Workshops Offer a Holiday Break
events.latest_developments: NEXTpittsburgh published a guide Monday, November 23, to 10 hands-on holiday craft workshops around Pittsburgh where participants make gifts and decorations in a single class.
events.why_it_matters: The list gives residents a holiday outing beyond shopping and markets in the weeks before Christmas.

sources.title: Make your own holiday magic at these 10 Pittsburgh craft workshops

around_teams.title: Steelers Players Answer for Eagles Loss
around_teams.latest_developments: Troy Fautanu, Patrick Queen, Max Hurleman, Jaylen Warren, and Roman Wilson took questions on the Week 11 loss at Philadelphia in a Press Pass video the Steelers posted Sunday, November 22.
around_teams.why_it_matters: The session delivers the first player accounts of a defeat that leaves the Steelers facing the same offensive questions raised after the Cincinnati trip.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: The team also posted a short clip Sunday afternoon marking receiver Roman Wilson's return, captioned "Roman is back."

sources.title: Fautanu, Queen, Hurleman, Warren & Wilson on loss at Eagles | Press Pass | Pittsburgh Steelers
Roman is back‼️ 📺: CBS

team_usa.title: Rodman Rues Third Straight Championship Loss
team_usa.latest_developments: Washington Spirit forward Trinity Rodman said the Spirit's third consecutive National Women's Soccer League Championship defeat hurts far worse than the previous two, ESPN reported.
team_usa.why_it_matters: The result shifts the balance of power in the league that supplies most of the United States women's national team ahead of a World Cup year.

details.label: The big picture
details.text: The Kansas City Current won their first title, and ESPN argued the victory shows sustained investment in women's soccer pays off.

sources.title: Rodman on 3rd straight NWSL Championship loss: 'This one hurts way worse'
Kansas City's NWSL title shows investing in women's soccer pays off
